title: Development of the Tasks Management Page
description:
The tasks management page was designed to allow users to efficiently add, edit, delete, and view tasks. Each task consists of a title and a detailed description, with the following functionalities:

  • Add Task: Users can add new tasks through a form that displays on demand. Once submitted, the newly added task appears at the top of the list. The task includes a title and description, which can be formatted using rich text features such as paragraphs, numbered lists, font size adjustments, and bold text.
  • Task Description Display: Each task initially displays a truncated version of the description, limited to a few lines. To view the full content of the task, the user can click a "Show More" button, which expands the task. Upon clicking, all other expanded tasks collapse to maintain clarity. The "Show More" button changes to "Show Less" when expanded, providing a toggle mechanism.
  • Task Actions: Each task item features two action icons:
  • A blue edit icon (on the right side) to open an edit form, allowing users to modify the task title and description.
  • A red delete icon, also on the right side, which triggers a confirmation dialog before permanently deleting the task.
  • Task Deletion Confirmation: When a user clicks the delete icon, a dialog box pops up asking for confirmation before the task is removed from the list. This feature prevents accidental deletions.
  • User-Friendly Design: The task description area is visually separated by a gradient effect, which creates a seamless transition between the description and the "Show More/Less" button. This gradient effect provides continuity and encourages the user to expand the content.
  • Data Persistence: Tasks are stored locally and persist after refreshing the page. This ensures that user tasks remain intact even after a browser reload. Additionally, the tasks can be pushed to version control (GitHub), enabling team members to clone the project and retain all previously created tasks.

The tasks management page provides a robust and intuitive interface for handling task data, focusing on ease of use and seamless functionality.
